summary.review_summary: Round 11 review completed 2025-12-11. ALL 5 audit items validated and resolved as @audit-ok with inline annotations.

findings.original_concern: KZG commitment verification for blob transactions
findings.resolution: VERIFIED SECURE. KZG verification mandatory for ALL blob transactions via VerifyBlobProof (legacy, validation.go:202) or VerifyCellProofs (Osaka, validation.go:208). Uses trusted setup embedded at kzg4844.go:30. Dual backend support (gokzg/ckzg) with atomic flag. Commitment hash validation at line 181. BLS12-381 pairing checks cryptographically enforce data availability. NO EXPLOITABLE VULNERABILITY.

findings.original_concern: Blob base fee determinism using fakeExponential Taylor series
findings.resolution: VERIFIED SECURE. fakeExponential uses ONLY big.Int integer arithmetic (NO floating point). Loop termination GUARANTEED: accum reduced by two consecutive divisions per iteration (lines 228-229), ensuring accum.Sign() reaches 0. Taylor series approximation deterministic across all platforms. Consensus-critical property correctly implemented. NO EXPLOITABLE VULNERABILITY.

findings.original_concern: Transaction signature validation with EIP-155 replay protection
findings.resolution: VERIFIED SECURE. Already marked @audit-ok at validation.go:116. types.Sender performs ECDSA secp256k1 recovery with fork-appropriate signer. Signature malleability protection confirmed: ValidateSignatureValues (crypto.go:244) enforces s <= secp256k1N/2 (line 250) per EIP-2 for Homestead+. ChainID binding in signature digest prevents replay attacks. All transaction types validated (legacy through EIP-7702). NO EXPLOITABLE VULNERABILITY.

findings.original_concern: Intrinsic gas validation prevents under-gassed transactions
findings.resolution: VERIFIED SECURE. IntrinsicGas computed with multi-component formula: 21000 base (53000 for contract creation) + calldata (4 gas/zero byte, 16 gas/non-zero post-EIP-2028) + access list (2400/address, 1900/storage key) + init code (2 gas/32-byte word post-EIP-3860) + authorization list (25000 per auth, EIP-7702). Validation at line 136 rejects tx.Gas() < intrGas BEFORE mempool propagation. DoS prevention correctly implemented. NO EXPLOITABLE VULNERABILITY.

VERIFIED SECURE. Two-tier validation architecture: (1) Stateless floor check at validation.go:176 ensures blobGasFeeCap >= 1 wei minimum. (2) Stateful market-rate check in blobpool: CalcBlobFee computes current blob base fee from excessBlobGas (blobpool.go:463,886) and admission filter rejects tx.blobFeeCap < current blob base fee (blobpool.go:1980). Defense-in-depth prevents underpriced blob spam. Economic security correctly implemented. NO EXPLOITABLE VULNERABILITY.

summary.next_focus: All priority audit items resolved. Recommend continued monitoring of: (1) Timing side-channels in KZG verification (non-exploitable for DA but may leak blob content metadata), (2) UseCKZG atomic flag race conditions (low risk, defensive verification), (3) Extreme excessBlobGas fuzzing for fakeExponential edge cases.
